# VISIT-2026-09-24: the branch visit as the conversion spine

Conductor direction, 2026-09-24, from the owner's brief of the same day: six
real photographs of the Al Khalidiyah branch, the Google Maps listing, and
"store visits should be emphasised and conversion optimised, considering that
OptimalX mainly focuses on subscriptions and packages achieved after a free
advisory and InBody test, besides the products we sell".

The funnel this direction builds: a shopper sees a real place with a real
rating, is offered a free advisory with a free body-composition measurement
at that place, books the visit (the branch-visit booking product) or opens
directions, and buys a plan or a subscription in the room. Every product
page ends on the same offer. Nothing here changes the hero, the type tiles,
the goal cards or the card design; those are owner-approved and stay.

## 3. Rules that bind every surface

- The rating renders only through `StoreRating` (`app/components/common/StoreRating.tsx`), which reads the four `google_*` settings through `readStoreRating` and refuses to render without all of them. No `aggregateRating` in structured data, ever (`content/social-proof.ts` rule 1). No quoted reviews: `CURATED_REVIEWS` stays empty until the owner exports them (rule 2 and `QUOTE_EXCLUSIONS`); the three reviews visible on the public page today each trip a filter (a title, a superlative), which confirms the rule.
- Every fact is gated on its setting as today (address, hours, map link, WhatsApp number, pickup numbers). The preview overlay `fixtures/store/overlay/settings.json` carries the listing's real values so the owner reviews the finished composition; the owner fills the same values in the Salla dashboard (owner-checklist) and the Shopify theme ships them as initial values.
- InBody is a measurement (قياس تكوين الجسم), gated on `inbody_included`; never a test, a diagnosis or an outcome. The booking verb is the catalogue's (`channelById('visit')`: احجز زيارتك). No titles for the advisor. Copy is MSA, no marks, no em-dash, `check-copy` and `check-claims` gates apply.
- Identity: sharp corners, one diagonal cut per photo panel (the `ox-x-corner` family), no strap, the angled primary (white on orange) and the angled secondary, the owner's icons (`map-pin`, `branch-visit`, `store`, `clock`, `phone`, `whatsapp`, `star`).
- Performance: the map is a facade that loads the embed iframe only on tap; photographs lazy below the fold; no third-party script.

## 4. Surfaces

### 4.1 Home: the branch block moves up and becomes the visit offer (V1)

- Order (`defaults.ts`): `ox-services` → `ox-branch` → `ox-guides` (the branch follows the advisory band it fulfils). Update `HOME_BLOCK_HEIGHTS['ox-branch']` after measuring.
- `OxBranch` (shared with `/branch`) gets the `store-wide` photograph as its panel (the block was designed for a real photograph and has waited for one), the one corner cut it already draws, and:
  - `StoreRating` (rail variant) under the title: stars, 5.0, "تقييم المتجر على خرائط Google", 80 reviews, the verified date.
  - actions, in this order: primary "احجز زيارتك" (the branch-visit product, `channelById('visit').to`, 48 px, white on orange); secondary "الاتجاهات" (`map-pin` icon, the directions URL from `BRANCH_LISTING`, new tab); a quiet WhatsApp button (existing key) and the existing "صفحة الفرع" link on the home block only.
  - one line under the title on the home block: the visit offer in one sentence, reusing `ox.content.services.visit_inbody` when `inbody_included` is on (the measurement is included with the visit), else nothing new.
  - the hours table and the open/closed chip render as today once `branch_hours` is set.
- The `زيارة الفرع` content poster in the "اكتشف أكثر" rail (`app/content/posters.ts`, `about-store.webp` today) takes the `storefront` photograph (its slot is 309 to 352 px wide, inside the 415 px source).

### 4.2 The advisory band, home and `/services` (V1)

- The offer strip gets a photo panel: `advisory-room` (portrait) beside the two facts at 768 px and above, under them below; the plate keeps its cut; the photograph carries `alt` from a new key (the advisor's room at the branch, no name, no title).
- The trust row gains the `StoreRating` inline chip as its first item.
- The visit door's CTA stays "احجز زيارتك"; no door takes a photograph (the three doors stay one set).

### 4.3 Product page advisory plate (V1)

- `AdvisoryCta` adds the `StoreRating` inline chip beside the closing note, and a third quiet link "الاتجاهات إلى الفرع" (`map-pin`, the directions URL) after the two buttons. Nothing else changes; the plate stays compact.

### 4.4 `/branch` (V2)

- Under the lead: `StoreRating` rail.
- `OxBranch` with the `store-wide` panel (from V1's shared component; V2 only passes the photo).
- New `BranchGallery`: the four other photographs (`storefront`, `shelves`, `advisory-room`, `waiting-area`) as a two-up grid at 640 px and above, a rail below; sharp corners; a short caption each from new keys (`ox.content.branch.photo_storefront`, `photo_shelves`, `photo_advisory`, `photo_waiting`); the first tile carries the corner cut; `loading="lazy"`.
- `BranchMap`: the no-key state becomes a click-to-load map. The plate shows the `storefront` photograph at its native size beside the address and the landmark, and one button "عرض الخريطة"; tapping it swaps the plate for the embed iframe (title from `map_alt`, `loading="lazy"`, `referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"`, sandboxed only if the embed still works sandboxed; verify). Under the map, two buttons: "الاتجاهات" (directions URL) and "افتح في خرائط Google" (the listing URL from `google_place_url`, which also carries the reviews). The SallaMap branch with an API key stays first.
- A mobile sticky bar on `/branch` and `/services`: "احجز زيارتك" (primary) with the open/closed chip when hours parse, using the same body-class convention the PDP sticky bar uses so the tab bar hides. Gated on the visit product existing.
- The do-list keeps its "احجز الآن" secondary on the last item.

## 6. Tests

- `BRANCH_LISTING` URLs are exact strings; the directions URL carries the listing pin.
- `StoreRating` mounts on the home branch block, the advisory trust row, the PDP plate and `/branch`, and renders nothing when any setting is missing.
- The gallery renders only slugs in the manifest and every `srcset` width exists on disk.
- The map facade renders no iframe before the tap and one after.
- The overlay hours parse to two rows with Friday at 16:00.
